posts.name: lynkfox
posts.cooked:
Does anyone want to help me playtest it? Send me a PM. It's a game about building a machine for the 1900's World Fair. It's slightly silly, and I've only actually /played/ it out a few times so I'm sure it has lots and lots of bad interactions and problems to find out. It's also a lot of printing/cutting, with about 35 pages worth of cards to print/cut. 

 

It is for 2-6 players, and you'll need some kind of tokens to use that can be easily seen whose is whose (i use colored buttons - but i have a ton of those lying around for other reasons) - It should take probably about 15-30 minutes to play... i think. heh.

 

 

either PM me your email or email me at lynkfox@gmail.com I can email the files to you (PDF) or i can link your gmail to them in my gdrive. If you aren't interested, no hard feelings :)

 

(edit: added information)

 

Oh, and I'd hope you'd give me feedback ;) No hard feelings if you think its stupid either, or if you find major game breaking problems. I'm not married to any of this thing (and its already gone through a few different design iterations) just hope for some constructive feedback!

posts.name: cmschex
posts.cooked: Is it a head to head Magic type game with pre built decks or is it more liek a deck builder?
posts.raw: Is it a head to head Magic type game with pre built decks or is it more liek a deck builder?

posts.name: lynkfox
posts.cooked:
its 2-6 players, competitive, but with centralized decks.  Not a deck builder, but it borrows from some concepts that deckbuilders use (central row, resource management)

 

Players have pick resources off Location cards (in a center row), which are used to play Operations cards from their hands (Drawn from a single community deck) - these cards either are events or parts, and the goal is to get the most points out of your parts by the time someone completes a Machine. Machines are completed by having 1 of each of the 5 needed parts in play. 

 

and Donner, this is in such very early phases of testing, that it's gonna be going on for a long while. You can always bug me at a later date when you have the resources to print it out :)

Nope. I just randomly attributed a year to it. Its ... somewhat pasted on theme right now, somewhat not. The theme is there, in the cards, but the 'reasoning' can adjusted as I do more research. I finally got it to a point today where I felt like I could put it out for some people to play around with (and expect LOTS of problems, as i've pretty much just played it schizo like by myself) so i threw on a quick blurb to explain the reasons why you are doing what your doing, and let it go at that.

 

It's more fantastical/steampunk than realistic fiction as well.
